Me, I have farmed here in Ruvuma for many years. This small maize plot of mine, only one tenth of a hectare, I keep it close to the homestead and I intercrop it with beans and pumpkins so the soil gives more and my wife has food for the pot. The rains here are usually enough, so I do not need to irrigate — God brings the water. I will buy a small bag of DAP and urea if the price at the shop is not too much, and I still put the kraal manure from my few goats. Hiring labor costs money I do not have much of, so my sons and I will do most of the work by hand hoe.
